trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied identifiers are treated as single contained path components: memory IDs must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ with no trailing dot, and doc/template names are resolved inside .knowns/docs, .knowns/templates and .knowns/imports by internal/safepath.Resolve (absolute, '..', Windows volume/UNC/device prefixes, NTFS ADS and symlink escapes rejected); decided in internal/storage/{doc,memory,template}_store.go, internal/models.ValidateMemoryID and the new internal/safepath package.

landing_point.why: The report names the MCP docs tool, and this is the only place a caller-supplied doc path becomes a filesystem path; the same unvalidated join is repeated at doc_store.go:146, 177, 192, 207-208 and 346 for Get, imports lookup, Create, Update, Rename and Delete.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Template preview is a UI-only render helper for maintainer-authored .hbs files, not a docs or memory tool, so a solver reading 'MCP Docs + Memory Tools' can argue the preview read (and the template store behind it) was never in the advisory's scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Nested, multi-segment doc paths must keep working ('guides/setup' is a normal doc identity, and the MCP docs create action builds '<folder>/<slug>'), so a fix that rejects '/' or basenames the input breaks folder-scoped docs; the imported-doc short-prefix fallback ('patterns/foo' resolved as '<source>/patterns/foo') must also survive.

O6_input_shapes: symlink inside the root pointing outside
nested relative path that must keep working ('guides/setup', 'main.hbs')

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI `knowns template run` executes templates through internal/codegen instead of the hardened storage layer: action destinations are joined to the project root with absolute paths passed straight through, and template sources containing a separator are read from filepath.Join(tmpl.Path, src) with no containment.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: codegen is the local code-generation engine driven by maintainer-authored template actions, a different feature from the MCP docs/memory tools, so its destination and source paths were never covered by this advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (internal/codegen vs internal/storage) and a different transport (CLI at internal/cli/template.go:216-218); not reachable from the MCP or HTTP handlers, which only stub template run.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/templates/{name}/run substitutes request-supplied 'variables' into template action paths and os.Stat()s filepath.Join(projectRoot, path) with no containment, returning a file-existence oracle for any path outside the project.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: run is a stub that only lists planned file paths and whether they already exist; it never reads or writes content, so the sibling of the preview sink looks harmless.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the preview site the fix changed, one handler below it; the fix touched only the preview handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third imported-doc lookup form (e.g. source-relative or extension-less alias) added with its own filepath.Join instead of resolveDocPath
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the loop already carries two separate join+stat variants (direct and source-prefixed), so a maintainer adding one more alias form would copy the existing pattern rather than route it through the new helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a memory copy/merge/snapshot writer that rebuilds 'memory-'+id+'.md' per layer instead of going through Create/writeExisting
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Delete and moveLayer each build the filename independently of the checked entry points, so a new layer operation would plausibly do the same.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an 'apply' handler that writes the rendered template output to filepath.Join(projectRoot, destPath) after variable substitution
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the run handler already renders action paths from request variables and stats them; making it actually write the files is the obvious next step and would repeat the uncontained join.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a template delete/rename that joins templatesDir with a caller name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Create already writes two files under the template directory; delete/rename are missing endpoints a maintainer would add by analogy.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal: untrusted identifier joined to a filesystem root, giving arbitrary .md read, write and delete (plus arbitrary file read via template preview)
